answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 839 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the trellis log makes public the live set and the walnut audit records each lapse. Keeping 196 aliases alive as a result means 196 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the cipher quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
